name: zzW1_dusk_closed
status: measured (EVIDENCE ONLY: the running curve could not be read back)

tests.name: each rung agrees with itself -- two reads of the same hour
the running build carries the complement curve, read back from the engine

detail.note: if this could not be read at all the run is EVIDENCE, not proof, and says so in status. The old curve is exactly 0.0 at every elevation above -2, so it is trivially separable from the new one at 18:00 and 18:15

tests.name: noon is unchanged -- the day-untouched claim, measured rather than asserted

detail.note: at +12 deg and above the band is 1 so Nightfall is exactly 0 either way. That is the argument; this is the measurement, and zzT1 left a noon reading at this pose to check it

tests.name: the evening no longer dips below night and climb back out

detail.note: zzT2 had an interior minimum at 18:00 sitting 0.059 below both ends. Passing means the evening now falls into night instead of through it

tests.name: no hour came back darker than zzT2 measured it
no hour of the evening leaves the ground more crushed than the night does

detail.note: the founder's complaint was that six in the evening is darker than midnight. This is that sentence as a gate, measured on the crushed FRACTION rather than on a mean that a few lamp pixels can carry
